viewer: Grad students starting school in fall 2026 who need about $50,000 in private loans now that federal borrowing is capped.
decision: Take a 7.5% variable rate or lock in 9% fixed for a 10-year payoff?
promise: We run the variable loan through every 10-year stretch of short-term rate history to see how often the cheaper start ended up costing more.
title: 7.5% Variable or 9% Fixed? Grad Loans Through History
